parameters.content:
## ⚙️ TRIGGER & CONFIG
Weekly schedule kicks this off. Pulls client config + reads the Business Config and Control tabs from the master Google Sheet to know which companies to process and whether they're grouped or per-driver billing.

## 🔁 PER-COMPANY LOOP: PULL & FILTER LOADS
Loops through each company one at a time. Reads that company's load tab, filters out anything already invoiced, and checks if there are any unbilled loads left to process.

nodes.name: Section - 🔁 PER-COMPANY LOOP: PULL & FILTER LOADS

parameters.content:
## 👤 PATH A — PER-DRIVER INVOICES
Groups loads by driver, loops each driver, generates their own invoice #, builds the HTML, renders a PDF via Gotenberg, updates the sheet, marks loads invoiced, and emails that driver's invoice.

## 📄 PATH B — GROUPED COMPANY INVOICE
Builds one invoice covering all of the company's unbilled loads together, generates the invoice number, renders PDF via Gotenberg, updates the sheet, marks loads invoiced, and emails the company one combined invoice.

nodes.name: Section - 📄 PATH B — GROUPED COMPANY INVOICE
